bug_info.bug_desc: The sd_en_o output-enable generation was gated by a clock-phase condition and otherwise held from a registered snapshot (sd_en_ff_q). Because sd_en_ff_q is updated every cycle from sd_en_o, including while all chip selects are deasserted where sd_en_o is forced to 0, the hold path could present a stale or zero output-enable value to sd_en_o when the SPI clock phase condition changed. This caused glitches or incorrectly deasserted data output enables during active SPI segments.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the sck/drive_posedge-qualified mux and the sd_en_ff_q feedback path. Compute sd_en_o combinationally whenever any chip select is asserted, using cmd_wr_en_q/cmd_wr_en_last_bit and speed_o directly, and force all enables to 0 only when all chip selects are deasserted. Unused signals such as drive_posedge and sd_en_ff_q may be deleted.
